name: Welcome Series
goal: Turn a new email subscriber into a first order by helping them pick the right material and size, and by giving them clear reasons to buy their millwork here.
trigger: Profile is added to the Newsletter list (popup, footer form, or account signup with email consent). Klaviyo: List trigger - 'Added to list: Newsletter'.
flow_filters: Placed Order zero times since starting this flow.

From E2 on: customer_type is not contractor, builder, designer or architect (pros move to Pro Welcome). Build this as a conditional split before E2, E3 and E4 that exits pros, not as a flow filter, so pro-form signups still receive E1 and their code.
exit_conditions: Places any order, including a samples-only order (Post-Purchase or Sample-to-Order takes over).
customer_type is set to a pro value: exits at the next pro split (before E2, E3 or E4) and Pro Welcome takes over.
Unsubscribes from email or is suppressed.
smart_sending: Email on (16h) for all four emails, per the cross-flow rule. A brand-new subscriber has no recent sends, so E1 is not at risk; check the 'skipped: Smart Sending' count on E1 after two weeks and raise it if it is more than a handful.

branches.label: Offer path (default)
branches.rule: Never ordered before and {{ WELCOME_OFFER }} is live. Gets E1-E4 as written.

branches.label: No-offer path
branches.rule: Trigger split at entry: Placed Order at least once over all time (past customers are not eligible for a first-order offer) OR {{ WELCOME_OFFER }} is not confirmed. Sends the alt_versions of E1 and E4; E2 and E3 are the same for everyone.

build_notes: Welcome code: {{ welcome_code }} maps to Klaviyo {% coupon_code 'WELCOME' %}. Klaviyo only auto-creates unique codes for platforms it has a coupon integration with; for Miva, plan on creating a batch of single-use, first-order-only codes in Miva and uploading them to Klaviyo as a coupon pool. Confirm with whoever owns the Miva integration.

Code window: E1 says the code is good for 10 days and E4 (day 8) says it ends in 48 hours, so set the code to expire 10 days after it is issued. E4 must show the same code E1 issued, not a fresh one (a coupon tag issues a new code each time it renders). Options: (a) write the issued code back to a welcome_code profile property via Miva or a webhook and reference that property in E4; (b) use one static WELCOME code with first-order-only and a per-customer 10-day window enforced in Miva. If neither is possible, remove the 48-hour wording from E4 before launch.

Offer scope: confirm whether the welcome code applies to made-to-order and Design Your Own builder items. The cross-flow guardrail says no percentage off made-to-order items in automated messages unless margin allows. If they are excluded, add 'Excludes made-to-order items.' to the E1 and E4 code callouts (and to SMW-S1). The copy never pairs the code with made-to-order products.

No-offer path (branch N): trigger split at entry. YES (past customer, or offer not live) sends the E1 and E4 alt_versions. For past customers change 'Your first 5% back' to 'Your next 5% back' in the E4 alt.
Reply-to: set to cs@architecturaldepot.com. The E1 P.S. invites replies with photos and measurements, and E3 asks for measurements by email.

Pro links in E3: four links to the homepage carrying ?pro=contractor, ?pro=builder, ?pro=designer and ?pro=architect. Build a small helper flow: trigger = Clicked Email, trigger filter URL contains 'pro=' -> conditional split on the value -> Update Profile Property customer_type. That enters Pro Welcome and exits this flow at the next split. The UTM step must append with '&' because these URLs already carry a '?'. Alternative: point the four links at a Klaviyo-hosted page with a customer_type field.

Flow priority: Welcome ranks below Post-Purchase, Cart, Sample-to-Order, Depot Dollars, Back in Stock and Browse. Before E2 and E3, add a split 'currently in flow Cart & Checkout Abandonment OR Browse Abandonment' -> YES skips that email. E4 keeps only Smart Sending, because the code deadline matters most to someone who is mid-checkout.

Samples-only orders count as Placed Order and end this flow (Sample-to-Order takes over). If the business wants the welcome code to survive a sample purchase, change the filter to exclude samples-only orders, and decide whether the code may be used on samples at all.

E2 sample links: the vinyl shutter color kit links to /LVSAMPLECOLORS.html; a second kit lives at /BESAMPLECOLORS.html. Confirm which shutter line each kit matches and add the second link if both apply.
Review block in E4: pull a real, published review only. Never write, paraphrase or combine reviews.

blocks.text: Hi {{ first_name|default:'there' }}, two questions settle most material choices: is it going inside or outside, and do you want to paint it, stain it, or get the look of wood with no upkeep?

items.title: Polyurethane (Endurathane)
items.text: Crisp, detailed shapes for corbels, crown moulding and ceiling medallions. A good fit when you plan to paint.

items.title: Timberthane faux wood
items.text: Our faux wood beam material. The look of wood, maintenance-free, and the new generation is even more realistic.

items.title: AmeriCraft real wood
items.text: Stain-grade hardwoods, for when you want real grain under a stain.

items.title: PVC
items.text: Often chosen for exterior trim and accents. Confirm it's rated for where it's going.

items.title: Fiberthane
items.text: Ekena's fiberglass line. Look for it on columns.

items.title: SteelTek
items.text: Metal brackets and shutter hardware, for a slim metal look.

blocks.title: Inside or outside?
blocks.text: Before you order for a porch, eave or entry, check that the piece is rated for exterior use, or ask us.

A sample in your own light settles it. See the detail up close with the [polyurethane sample](https://www.architecturaldepot.com/SAMPLE-URETHANE.html), or hold the 7" x 10" [Timberthane sample](https://www.architecturaldepot.com/BM-MAT-SAMPLE.html) right against your ceiling. Shopping for shutters? Try a [vinyl shutter color sample kit](https://www.architecturaldepot.com/LVSAMPLECOLORS.html).

steps.ps: P.S. Torn between two materials? Call 1-888-573-3768 and tell us the room and the finish you want.

hero.headline: Get the size right the first time
hero.subhead: Answer these before you order beams, corbels, shutters or moulding.
hero.image: Hands holding a tape measure up to a kitchen ceiling where a beam will run, painter's tape outlining the beam's width on the drywall, a pencil tucked behind an ear. Natural daylight.

blocks.text: Hi {{ first_name|default:'there' }}, most sizing mistakes happen before anyone opens a product page. These questions catch them.

items.title: How long is the run?
items.text: Measure wall to wall for beams. For moulding, total every wall and add extra for cuts.

items.title: How big should it look?
items.text: Tape a paper template where it will go and look from across the room. Size to the space, not the photo.

items.title: What's it fastened to?
items.text: Know what's behind it: joists, studs or sheathing.

items.title: Does it hold anything?
items.text: If a corbel or bracket will carry a shelf or counter, call us before you choose one.

blocks.text: **Can't find your size?** Our Design Your Own builders make custom [faux wood beams](https://www.architecturaldepot.com/BM.html), [corbels](https://www.architecturaldepot.com/BUILDER-COR.html), [brackets](https://www.architecturaldepot.com/BUILDER-BKT.html) and [flat trim](https://www.architecturaldepot.com/BUILDER-FLT.html) at off-the-shelf prices. Custom pieces are made to order, so they can't be returned. Double-check your numbers, or send them to us first.
Want a second set of eyes? Call 1-888-573-3768 (Mon-Fri 8am-6pm CT, Sat 8am-12pm CT) or email cs@architecturaldepot.com with your measurements and a photo of the space.

**Are you a pro?** If you're a [contractor](https://www.architecturaldepot.com/?pro=contractor), [builder](https://www.architecturaldepot.com/?pro=builder), [designer](https://www.architecturaldepot.com/?pro=designer) or [architect](https://www.architecturaldepot.com/?pro=architect), click yours and we'll send trade-focused help instead.

steps.ps: P.S. Exterior project? Check that the piece is rated for outdoor use before you order.

blocks.text: Hi {{ first_name|default:'there' }}, before you check out, here's how buying here works:

items: Price match: find the exact same product for less at another online home improvement store, shipping included and shippable within 10 business days, and we'll refund the difference.
Returns: most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a partial refund, less a 20% processing fee. Return shipping is on you.
Made to order: vinyl and wood shutters and anything from a Design Your Own builder are built for you and can't be returned, so double-check measurements first.
5% back: your order earns Depot Dollars, ready to use once it ships.
